stories.title: "If Newton saw the way I be moving" he'd add a fourth law of motion
stories.summary: A one-line brag posted Friday afternoon, "If newton saw the way I be moving these days he'd add a fourth law of motion," passed 1M views and 94K likes within a day and is now at 220K likes and 2.9M views. By the next morning accounts everywhere were reposting it word for word or swapping in a footballer, a friend or a celebrity whose form seemed to defy physics, and X News ran a story on it. The same day, Swifties went after Knicks guard Tyler Kolek for calling Taylor Swift the team's "fakest" celebrity fan, and the Knicks put out a statement defending her.
